status: implementation specification; no audio generated or auditioned in this documentation change
envelope: Per note/glide: sin(pi * sample_index / sample_count); amplitude is zero at start; terminate with zero sample to avoid clicks. Linear frequency glide integrates phase sample by sample. Sequence notes concatenate their separately enveloped samples. Explosion is 0.55*sine + 0.45*seeded uniform noise before envelope.
clip_sample_count: ceil(duration_seconds * 22050); sequence note lengths rounded with final total corrected to this count
gain_semantics: AudioSource.volume 0.2 × per-cue PlayOneShot volumeScale gain × samples peak 0.5; no second arbitrary master multiplier
priority: victory/failure > explosion > countdown > collectible/purchase > launch/unavailable; at capacity drop lowest-priority oldest sound only
shared_sound_setting: data.SoundEnabled via injected getter; shell sound-off callback calls StopAll immediately
lifecycle: StopAll on pause/focus loss/page exit; discard past events and do not replay on resume. Destroy generated AudioClip objects and AudioSource objects on disposal. Generate/cache only on Gold Miner entry.
